name: catface
description: Shows your cat's face in the status bar, reacting to how many errors/warnings are in your code.

catface.warningsCountTowardMood.description: Whether warnings (not just errors) affect your cat's mood.

catface.defaultMessage.default: Bubbles has no clue how to feel (No messages to display)
catface.defaultMessage.description: Default message shown when no message strings found for threshold

catface.defaultImage.description: Default image displayed when no image found for threshold

catface.bulletStyle.description: Bullet style for the list of messages in the webview. Can be any valid CSS list-style-type value.

catface.errorColor.description: Color for error messages in the webview.

catface.warningColor.description: Color for warning messages in the webview.
